run_ddppo_trainer: run the DD-PPO distributed reinforcement learning trainer for audio navigation tasks
setup_actor_critic_agent: setup actor-critic agent with RNN or Scene Memory Transformer policy for audio navigation
train_belief_predictor: train the belief predictor network for location prediction during RL training
resume_interrupted_training: resume DD-PPO training from a previously saved interrupted state checkpoint
collect_rollout_step: collect a single rollout step from the environment using the current policy
